note: Saved by the orchestrator from the agent's returned JSON (reactions condensed).

first_impression.why: Plain headline, real-work hero, intro describes us; would save and send to Marcus.

fears_coverage.note: For planners in general; reopened for the company by the 'ask your concierge' line.

fears_coverage.fear: Planning from the other side of the world
Losing control of the budget across currencies and contracts

unanswered_questions: What does the concierge cost, and how is it charged?
Do you take commission or referral fees from partnered planners? Yes or no.
Who exactly would we talk to? Named advisor, in Sydney?
Realistic planner fee for 90 guests over three days at Como or Tuscany?
How many of the 800 were in Italy, for Australians?
How are partnered planners vetted beyond 'worked with in-market'?
How far ahead to book for late May or June?
What happens after the free call: a proposal with a price?
payload.in_their_words: Marcus, read this one properly. The table of questions to ask planners is gold, and the kickback question is exactly what we need. Funny thing though: they tell you to make every planner disclose who pays them, then say 'ask your concierge' about their own arrangement. Feels like a no. I'd use the guide, but I'm not booking their call until I know their fee.

findings.quote: Ask your concierge the same question this guide asks of every planner: how the service is paid, and whether it receives anything from the partners it recommends.
findings.issue: Company does not disclose its own payment or referral arrangements; reopens fear 1 for the company.

findings.quote: Wedded Wonderland Concierge is not a wedding planner but a paid advisory service that starts with a free, no-obligation Discovery Call.
findings.issue: Paid service with no price or pricing model, contradicting the article's own advice.

findings.quote: The team has worked on more than 800 weddings and celebrations.
findings.issue: No named people, no Italy example, vague proof point.
Fee figures are whole-of-Italy and don't fit a three-day wedding for 90; fear 3 only touched.
Federconsumatori unexplained; consulate declarations not named or timed in the body.
Booking FAQ gives no lead time.
